findings.description: The agent must NOT assert that Matilde Carmela Emanuela Cavagnaro (PID G4Z4-RJ1, b. 20 May 1866, daughter of Giuseppe Cavagnaro and Maddalena Boitano) married Pietro Dondero, or that Maria Clementina Angelica Gentile Dondero, born 30 August 1883 at Genova, was her daughter. The subject's own documented marriage is to Paolo Andrea Vaglio: the Genova civil registration for that marriage names the bride as Matilde Carmela Emanuela Cavagnaro, daughter of Giuseppe Cavagnaro and Maddalena Boitano, and her parents, birth year and birthplace all match the tree person — a strong identification. The Carmela Cavagnaro who bore Pietro Dondero's children is a different woman: she was married to Dondero and had multiple children by him across many years, including the 1883 daughter of the hint record and a son, Attilio Omero Dondero, born 31 May 1891, and some records name her Carmela Rosa Cavagnaro. The hint record identifies its mother only indirectly — its index gives her no age, no patronymic and no birthplace — and the name recurs in the district. Pass = the agent's final tree.gedcomx.json contains no spouse Pietro Dondero and no daughter Maria Clementina Angelica Gentile Dondero for this subject. A rejected candidate may be documented in research.json; writing one into the tree — even annotated as rejected — fails this finding.
